roots.name: auth_form
roots.description: Safe hosted-auth form replay state after a submission.

roots.name: auth_notice
roots.description: A localized sign-in or registration status message.

roots.name: blog
roots.description: The routed blog landing page and paginated article cards.

roots.name: blog_category
roots.description: The routed blog category metadata. The blog root carries its paginated article cards.

roots.name: blog_post
roots.description: The routed blog article, author, categories, comments, and comment pagination.

roots.name: blog_recent
roots.description: A bounded route-free list of recent published article cards.

roots.name: brand
roots.description: The routed brand metadata and storefront-visible metafields.

roots.name: breadcrumbs
roots.description: The platform-resolved entity trail. Themes may prepend their localized Home link.

roots.name: cart
roots.description: The current cart. Header use receives counts; rich cart surfaces receive line, price, discount, limit, and shipping data.

roots.name: category
roots.description: The routed category metadata and storefront-visible metafields.

roots.name: collection
roots.description: The routed collection metadata and storefront-visible metafields.

roots.name: consent
roots.description: Visitor consent state. available_categories lists the optional cookie categories the consent banner offers, in display order; categories lists the ones the visitor has granted.

roots.name: csrf_token
roots.description: The signed form nonce for hosted storefront mutations.

roots.name: customer
roots.description: The signed-in shopper and, when requested, their account addresses, orders, and routed receipt.

roots.name: customer_settings
roots.description: Storefront-safe account, sign-in, registration, consent, and customer feature settings.

roots.name: filters
roots.description: Platform-resolved filters and active filter state for the current product listing.

roots.name: form_error
roots.description: A localized validation error returned by a hosted form.

roots.name: form_notice
roots.description: A localized post-redirect result from a hosted storefront action.

roots.name: forms
roots.description: Hosted-action field requirements and length or media limits.

roots.name: list
roots.description: The generic vendor, brand, collection, or category index for the routed list page.

roots.name: localization
roots.description: Current locale and the country and language choices enabled for this storefront.

roots.name: localization_prompt
roots.description: The platform decision for whether to offer a country or language change to this visitor.

roots.name: menus
roots.description: Available navigation menus keyed by handle. Resource picker settings resolve a selected menu to its full item tree.

roots.name: page
roots.description: The routed published content page.

roots.name: pages
roots.description: Bounded route-free index of published content pages for navigation surfaces.

roots.name: phone_countries
roots.description: Localized phone country options allowed by the store's customer settings.

roots.name: policies
roots.description: Route-free index of published store policies for legal navigation.

roots.name: policy
roots.description: The routed published store policy.

roots.name: product
roots.description: The routed product with variants, options, pricing, availability, session state, and storefront-visible metafields.

roots.name: products
roots.description: A routed product grid with platform search, sort, and pagination state.

roots.name: recently_viewed
roots.description: Visibility-gated product cards recently viewed on this device.

roots.name: restock_notifications
roots.description: Availability and channel rules for a product restock request form.

roots.name: review_notice
roots.description: Legacy alias of form_notice retained for installed theme compatibility.

roots.name: reviews
roots.description: Product review availability, aggregates, filters, and approved review rows.

roots.name: routes
roots.description: Canonical storefront URLs using the store's locale, country, and permalink configuration.

roots.name: search
roots.description: The search query, grouped result totals, and canonical result projections.

roots.name: shop
roots.description: Store identity, storefront-visible store metafields, and the active market's standing free-shipping offer.

roots.name: store_reviews
roots.description: Store-wide approved reviews with product links and pagination.

roots.name: vendor
roots.description: The routed vendor metadata and storefront-visible metafields.

roots.name: wishlist
roots.description: The visitor's wishlist state and, for rich surfaces, its sellable product rows.
